subject: ERROR: argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default

messages.author: 0521d492052ce0f0
messages.subject: ERROR: argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default
parts:
Hi

I have an app that works fine locally, was doing some edits yesterday and started getting this error consistently on Spark, when attempting to load the page in chrome.

ERROR: argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default

I now get this error regardless, for example a minimal application from the tutorial.   In fact, same error with no files at all in the target directory of ShinyApps.  Older apps on the same server load fine.

I've trawled the help list, but not many references to this error - any ideas?

Thanks

Giles

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: ERROR: argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default
parts: Hi Giles, thanks for the report. We've spent some time investigating this and for an unknown reason the version of Shiny that was running on spark.rstudio.com had been downgraded to 0.7.0 (instead of 0.9.1). We're still trying to figure out why this happened but in the meantime your apps should work now. Sorry for the inconvenience!
